meta.legacy_bug_note: The original _seed_diffs used a dict keyed by (variant, seed) after appending repeats 122, 123 and 124. Variants present only in 122 were compared with A0 from 124; overlapping A0/C1/B5 cells were overwritten by 124. The per-run table, the per-repeat cross_repeat table, the repeat-122 bootstrap point estimates, and all Valid predictions are unaffected.
